summary: First test run of Meu Pet Saúde (Expo + FastAPI + Mongo). Backend 16/16 pytest tests passed: device-id auth guard (401 on missing/short), pets CRUD with counts/last_weight/next_vaccine/overdue_vaccines, records CRUD per type, /api/upcoming filtering, ownership isolation between device ids (DEV1 vs DEV2 returns 404), /api/upload with multipart image, /api/files/{path} download with X-Device-Id header AND ?d= query param, cross-device file access blocked (404), /api/pets/{id}/report-data returning pet+records+images map. Frontend smoke test on mobile viewport (390x844): empty state renders, 'Add pet' flow works, pet-form accepts name + MM/DD/YYYY birth date (English locale default), pet dashboard shows name, stats and all 6 modules + quick illness. Exam module tap correctly routes to /paywall when not subscribed. Paywall loads RevenueCat offerings, shows Annual $79.99/year (Best value) and Monthly $9.99/month. Subscribe → confirm sheet shows plan+price+test-mode note. Clicking Confirm triggered RevenueCat's native web Test Store popup ('Test valid purchase / Test failed purchase / Cancel') — this native popup is outside the app DOM and cannot be auto-clicked in Playwright, so the premium unlock state (exam module unlock + report CTA unlock) could not be verified end-to-end via UI automation. Backend gating is correct by design (no server-side subscription state). No deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch usage detected in the referenced files.

integration_issues.issue: Confirm sheet opens the native RevenueCat Test Store web popup which is rendered outside the app DOM and cannot be automated. Post-purchase premium unlock (exam module unlock, report CTA unlock) is therefore unverified by automation. Manual verification recommended.

action_items: Manually verify post-purchase premium flow by clicking RevenueCat's 'Test valid purchase' button in the native popup, then confirming exam module unlocks and report CTA navigates to /pet/{id}/report instead of /paywall.
Consider adding a dev-only data-testid to the top-level app container to confirm the webview mounted; current app relies on screen-level testIDs only (minor).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_pet / list_pets / records all use PyObjectId with alias to produce 'id' (no raw _id leaks) — verified in responses.
/api/upcoming correctly filters by owner_id and uses $lte on next_date limit 90 days.
File download endpoint accepts both X-Device-Id header and ?d= fallback query param — both tested and working.
Free→Premium gating is correctly client-side (PREMIUM_TYPES includes 'exam'); confirmed exam tap routes to /paywall when !isSubscribed.
i18n: default English on web preview matches browser locale (expected per request). Dictionaries complete for pt/en/es/fr/de.
seed_data_creation: Pet 'TEST_Thor' + vaccine/weight records created and torn down via module-scoped fixtures. One UI-created pet 'Rex UI' left in DEV1 collection — safe to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (reusable). For next frontend iteration: to test premium-unlocked flows (exam module, report screen with section toggles and share), the main agent should either (a) stub isSubscribed=true in dev build, or (b) have the testing agent attempt to script the RevenueCat Test Store overlay via page.frames() or iframe selectors since the popup content ('Test valid purchase' button) was visible in screenshots. Device-id header used for API tests: testdevice00000000000000000000001 (DEV1) and ...002 (DEV2).
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Only limitation: RevenueCat native web Test Store popup is a browser-level overlay outside Playwright's default root frame — needs explicit iframe handling to click 'Test valid purchase'.
